description: Create the Jidoka-first implementation path for jido_cli. Keep CLI files, matrices, concurrency, terminal output, JSONL, exit status, and artifacts in jido_cli. Keep turns, session sequencing, effects, cancellation, persistence, recovery, execution environments, and extension runtime behavior in Jidoka. This epic does not add jido_eval, compare, or validate commands. It also does not permit agent or scenario data to load code or raw backend controls.
title: Implement the Jidoka-first jido_cli roadmap
